rows.name: D-version duty ceiling holds at brown-out
rows.detail: worst DCM duty 22.1% (brown-out min, Lp max, d4-flyback) ≤ 44.2% DCmax(min) — the A-version's 48% ceiling was never the constraint

rows.name: bank-bleeder PV gate drive (25 °C-endpoint model)
rows.detail: IF 11.58 mA ≥ 10 mA at the 13.5 V rail floor (R8: 1 k/2010, 0.23 W worst ≤ 50% of 0.75 W); chord 5.87 V ≥ Vth(max)+2 — a 25 °C-ENDPOINT MODEL (Voc typ ~5.4 V at 100 °C): bleed-interval ambient declared ≤70 °C, EVT loaded-Vgs gates the BOM freeze
